newsitem.title: USA: North Fork buys Branford Savings, moving into Connecticut.
newsitem.headline: North Fork buys Branford Savings, moving into Connecticut.

text.p: North Fork Bancorporation Inc. said Friday it bought Branford Savings Bank for $38 million in stock, beginning an expansion from its New York metropolitan base into New England.
North Fork, which has $6.6 billion in assets and operates 82 banks in the New York metropolitan area, will acquire five bank offices in New Haven County. Conn., with the purchase.
Branford Savings Bank has total assets of about $187 million.
Under the terms of the agreement, each share of Branford common stock will be exchanged for $5.25 of North Fork common stock. Branford closed Thursday at $5 a share on Nasdaq.
"From Branford, Conn., we intend to pursue a vigorous campaign of deposit gathering throughout New England," said John Adam Kanas, chairman of North Fork.
"We believe that the model we intend to create will serve as a blueprint for a much larger institution in a short period of time," he said.
North Fork's stock was unchanged at $25.375 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
